classification_definitions.integration: A real project service/API/network/OS/store boundary materially supports the assertion; scope actual effects and limitations.
classification_definitions.unit: Local predicate/transformation/decoding/clock/map or pre-I/O guard; incidental filesystem/listener setup is insufficient.
classification_definitions.mixed: Independent local-only assertion block(s) coexist with genuine boundary assertion block(s).
classification_definitions.unresolved: Insufficient or blocked source evidence; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.

func (a *Agent) terraBaseExited(observed Observation, d Desired, fingerprint string) bool {
	member := a.terraBase[d.Role]
	exited := !observed.Running && observed.Digest == d.Digest && observed.Fingerprint == fingerprint && !member.exited
	member.exited = exited
	a.terraBase[d.Role] = member
	return exited
}

Unmodified production OS inspection reaches the fixed /dev/oracleoci data-volume path and/or absent data directory. The fixture does not control/create a mounted device. Its process-stop assertion is simulated; no real mount-loss/process-stop qualification.

The root name/comment mentions Vault secrets, but a map supplies them directly. Real effect is owned directory creation; no Vault retrieval or replica launch is reached.
